name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Spotify listening tracker that polls your history and shows statistics in a web dashboard, backed by MongoDB.

alerts.message: A Spotify developer app is required. Create one in the Spotify developer dashboard with the Web API enabled, add https://api.<your domain>/oauth/spotify/callback as a redirect URI, then set SPOTIFY_PUBLIC (client ID) and SPOTIFY_SECRET (client secret) and redeploy. Other Spotify users must be added under User Management in that app.

The API is served on its own api. subdomain of the app domain, so a custom domain needs DNS for both names. Upstream reports that hostnames containing the word spotify can be flagged as deceptive by Google; prefer an app name and domain without it.
Anyone who can reach the site can sign in with a Spotify account allowed by your app. The first user is the administrator and can turn off new registrations in Settings.
MongoDB needs a CPU with AVX support on x86_64 servers.
